progress.metric.dps.label: DPS
progress.metric.dps.title: DPS per hunt
progress.metric.dps.note: Raw damage per second over your active window — sensitive to which monster you fought and how long the fight lasted.
progress.metric.index.label: vs usual
progress.metric.index.title: DPS vs your usual on that monster
progress.metric.index.note: 100% = your median DPS on the same monster across these hunts, so switching to a harder or easier fight stops reading as a slump or a spike.
progress.metric.share.label: Damage share
progress.metric.share.title: Damage share per hunt
progress.metric.share.note: Your part of the party's total damage — roughly flat when the whole party (or the monster's HP) changes, so it tracks your relative contribution.
progress.metric.clear.label: Clear time
progress.metric.clear.title: Clear time per hunt
progress.metric.clear.note: Finish time per quest (m:ss) — lower is better; mixes in damage, routing and monster uptime.
progress.empty.scope: They aren't in these hunts — pick something they joined.
progress.heading: {title} + {window}-hunt rolling average
